copy_policy: Aggregate and evaluation manifest bytes preserved exactly; raw individual metrics and recommendation files excluded.

2026.claims: No novelty, psychological interpretation, unbiased exposure, independent confirmation, or SOTA claim.
2026.cohorts: Original user partition: meta-fit selection; disjoint development evaluation. Reused validation is exploratory.
2026.conditional_rating_adapter: softmax over each item's five rating logits
2026.controls: Identical allocated parameters, initial weights, episodes and batch order; fixed_flow caches initial routes and gates jointly within each query.
2026.decomposition: joint NLL = conditional category NLL + item-event NLL, unit coefficients; only query-global logit shift remains invariant.
2026.inference: Original TRAIN ratings only; validation labels never enter context.
2026.likelihood_scope: One exchangeable recorded event conditional on eligible catalog, not binary ever-rated probability or chronological next event.
2026.negative_assumption: Missing pairs compete as possible recorded outcomes in the denominator; they are not observed dislikes. Selection/exposure biases remain.
2026.normalizer: All catalog items except padding and context observations, times five categories; all probes remain eligible.
2026.selection_direction: minimize; exact ties retain earlier checkpoint
2026.training_reduction: Mean masked-probe joint NLL per user, then mean across users.
